Container.Name: MediaLyze
Container.Overview: Self-hosted media library analysis for large collections with ffprobe-based technical insights and a web UI.
Container.Description:
MediaLyze analyzes large local media libraries and presents technical metadata through a web interface.

The application is designed for analysis rather than file modification, so media libraries should be mounted as read-only.

  • /config: persistent configuration and SQLite database storage.
  • /media/peliculas: movies library root mounted read-only.
  • /media/series: TV shows library root mounted read-only.

The official project describes the deployment model as a simple self-hosted setup focused on technical analysis, scan orchestration, and normalized metadata.
Container.Requires: Persistent storage for /config and read access to the media library paths.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: External port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Config (DB + config)
Config.Description: Persistent configuration and main SQLite database (*.db).
